messages:
maya: Heads up — saw a resume/reconnect pattern where a client reconnects, resume succeeds, but the tenant quota is charged twice. Console shows a single session but billing shows 2x token charge.

derek: Hmm. Do you have an example trace id? Is this on the sticky-routing rollout or the new resume-id mapping?

maya: trace=trc_2026_07_12_42, observed on prod us-west. Looks correlated with route failover (primary GPU -> fallback) during a heavy burst.

jules: If the resume token is opaque and routing changes host, we might replay the initial request on the fallback which re-counts. We intended resume to be idempotent by resume_id, but our quota key still uses connection_id+route.

ian: Console UX note: customers see "resumed" in Sessions table but no visibility on whether fallback was used. We should surface resume path and which route served the resumed tokens.

maya: Repro snippet: client sends header `X-Resume-Id: RXYZ` then issues streaming resume. If route swap occurs before server sync, fallback treats as new request.

jules: Proposed fix: unify quota key to include `resume_id` when present and add a short-lived resume->route mapping in redis with 30s TTL. That way any host can check idempotency.

derek: Agree but watch perf — hitting redis on every token could blow RPS. Maybe only check on resume handshake phase, not per-token.

jules: Right. Pseudocode: 
```
if (isResume(request)) {
  route = resumeCache.get(resume_id) || findRoute(request)
  if (!resumeCache.has(resume_id)) resumeCache.set(resume_id, route, ttl=30s)
}
applyQuotaKey = baseKey + (resume_id ? ":resume:"+resume_id : "")
```

telemetry-bot: Query suggestion for dashboards: `sum by (status, resume_path) (increase(stream_tokens_total{job="sse"}[5m]))` and add label_transform to map resume_id -> host in kafka logs for tracing.

ian: For the Console rollout UX: add a small inline badge "resume-fallback" on session rows and a popup showing route history + token delta; default off behind a feature flag.

maya: Can we do a quick canary? deploy-bot: I can push canary to 10% of traffic for the resume-id quota change. Confirming: will rename metric `stream_resume_replayed_tokens` and emit `resume_route` tag.

derek: Action items: (1) jules implements resume-cache + quota key change (2) emit resume_route tag from servicer (3) telemetry team adds dashboard panel and alert for replayed tokens > 0.5% of total (4) console team adds resume-fallback badge behind flag.

jules: I'll open PR for the runtime change. Will include microbenchmark numbers for the redis handshake.

maya: Thanks — leaving as priority P1 for routing/quotas since billing impact. cc @ian for console UX. :thumbsup:

ian: Will mock the badge and inject a link to the trace id. Will sync with product for rollout message.

maya: Marking follow-up meeting tomorrow 09:30 PT to coordinate canary and alerts.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-07-13T16:30:00Z -> 10% traffic, auto-rollback 5min on error rate increase > 1%.
